method: GitHub Actions Playwright/Chromium public-address UI test; no paid TinyFish agent, login or private residential address
observations: Both entered public addresses yielded the same first 3500 characters of the complete campus catalog following Find on Map.
No visible autocomplete option was produced for either test query in the tested session.
No explicitly identified zoned elementary/middle/high result was observed.
All listed campus cards showed Drive Time and Drive Distance Unknown in the tested session.
Navigation returned HTTP 200; no visible JavaScript page errors or failed browser requests were logged.
limitations: Cannot establish that GuideK12 is broken for all residents or residential unit records; these two public property types may lack the exact address needed by provider.
Presence of a school name or catalog card is never proof of address zoning.
No school has been assigned in dashboard based on this test.
nextStep: CFB enrollment/GuideK12 support should clarify correct address selection/lookup workflow or provide current property-level school map source; keep address-level assignment inconclusive.
